<thought>From the ¹H NMR spectrum, the signals corresponding to methyl protons are: a doublet at 1.43 ppm integrating to 3 H (one CH₃) and a singlet at 2.69 ppm integrating to 6 H (two equivalent CH₃ groups). This totals three distinct CH₃ groups in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
